thread:
Nadia L.: FYI I ran microburst-6b v3: baseline fp16 vs int6 quant on the longchat-support slice. Quick summary below.
Victor H.: awesome — paste the key deltas pls.
Nadia L.: slice=longchat-support-800 (avg 760 tokens). fp16 Rouge-L=33.8 / BERTScore=0.872. int6 Rouge-L=31.6 / BERTScore=0.861. p95 latency fp16=620ms int6=420ms. throughput +1.9x. cost/1k tokens fp16=$0.037, int6=$0.023.
Ravi P.: hallucination / failure modes?
Nadia L.: auto-eval (n=500): int6 hallucination flagged 6/500 (1.2%) vs fp16 1/500 (0.2%). Failures mostly are dropped context in deep threads (>10 turns) causing missing facts, not fabrications.
Victor H.: product note: billing and compliance flows must stay on fp16. We can consider int6 for general help and discovery.
Nadia L.: rough econ: site tokens/month ~120M. If route 35% traffic to int6 raw infra save ~= $6.5k/mo. Estimated cost of extra escalations at current misroute rate ~$2.8k/mo. Net ~+$3.7k/mo.
Ravi P.: can we mitigate with a cheap edge heuristic? maybe: prefer fp16 if last_user_msg_len > 300 or thread_turns > 8.
Nadia L.: tried that in a small sample; discriminator reduced bad routing by ~45% and only lowered int6 traffic by 6 percentage points.
ops-bot: Auto-eval run finished: sample=200 live queries -> int6 mean Rouge-L drop = 2.1 (sd 0.8). hallucination flagged 3/200.
Nadia L.: Proposed routing proto:
```yaml
route: longchat-support
rules:
  - if intent in [billing, legal] then model: microburst-fp16
  - elif thread_turns > 8 or last_msg_tokens > 300 then model: microburst-fp16
  - else model: microburst-int6
fallback: microburst-fp16
metrics: rouge_l, bertscore, hallucination_rate, cost_delta
```
Victor H.: Ask: add a 1.5% fp16 holdback and daily sampling to QA. Rollback triggers: hallucination_rate > 1% over 12h for billing/legal OR rouge_l drop > 1.8 average over 24h.
Ravi P.: I'll add edge heuristic and a small logging hook to capture classifier false negatives. ETA 48h.
Nadia L.: Canary plan: start 48h on 5% non-sensitive traffic, then 7d ramp to 35% with 1.5% fp16 holdback and daily auto-eval. I'll publish the GTN notes and a cost sheet.
QA Team: please sign off on sampling plan before we enable for any sensitive intents.
Victor H.: Thanks, team. Post updates here and tag me for compliance signoff. :thumbsup
file_notes: microburst-6b int6 bring-up: canary plan + routing heuristics + econ snapshot
